message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: selling counterfeit goods (handbags) that infringe trademark. This is "假冒注册商标的商品销售" which is crime of "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (counterfeiting trademark) or "销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". In Chinese criminal law, article 205? Actually "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" includes manufacturing, selling counterfeit goods. The examples: earlier similar case: "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" etc. For counterfeit goods, we have seen "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" but not this. Another example: "生产、销售有毒、有害食品". For counterfeit goods, typical label: "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". So answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>.

Check if multiple crimes? Only one. So output.
